title: Custom promotion type (Promotions SDK)
znode_versions: 10.0.0-rc-01 and later (package version in the sample)
summary: Add a promotion type with your own calculation logic by subclassing CartPromotionTypeBase from Znode.Libraries.Promotions.SDK and marking it with [PromotionExtension].
when_to_use: a discount rule the built-in promotion types cannot express
a discount that depends on custom conditions
not_for: a discount the built-in promotion types, price lists or coupons already cover: configure those instead (verdict: supported)
changing the order in which Znode applies promotions or taxes

contract.result: set result.OrderLevelDiscount = CreatePromoDiscount(amount, DiscountLevelCode.OrderLevel) and result.IsApplied = true
contract.context_per_kb: Context.PromotionBag (admin settings, user-defined attributes, coupons, promotion name, promo code); cart items, subtotal, quantity; cart UserId, ProfileId, PortalId, OrderId; ServiceProvider DI; SDK helpers for product/category/brand/catalog lookups (KB article, read through a summary: 70-80%)
contract.deployment_per_kb: znode deploy extension -> Sync in Admin > Extension Observability -> register the promotion type in Admin > Dev Center > Promotion Settings (Class Name = ClassName in code, case-sensitive) -> create the promotion in Marketing > Promotions

verified_by_reflection.package: Znode10.Libraries.Promotions.SDK 10.0.0-rc-01 (read with .NET reflection and IL on 2026-10-10)
verified_by_reflection.CartPromotionTypeBase: abstract Calculate(int? couponIndex, IReadOnlyList<IPromotionInfo> allPromotions); public props Name, Description, ClassName, Precedence, Context, ServiceProvider; virtual PreSubmitOrderProcess(), PostSubmitOrderProcess(); protected GetCartSubTotal(), GetCartQuantity() (decimal), GetQuantityOrdered(productId), IsDiscountApplicable(currentDiscount, finalPrice), CreatePromoDiscount(decimal amount, DiscountLevelCode level), CreateCouponDiscount(couponCode, amount, ...)
verified_by_reflection.CreatePromoDiscount: takes an ABSOLUTE amount, not a percentage: compute a percentage yourself
verified_by_reflection.GetCartQuantity: sum of line quantities plus selected group-product quantities; add-ons not counted (from IL)
verified_by_reflection.IPromotionCart: SubTotal, PortalId, ProfileId, OrderId, UserId, IsAnyPromotionApplied, CartItems, Coupons, GetTotalItemCount(), GetMaximumApplicableDiscountOnLineItem(...), GetDiscountAppliedSequence(code)
verified_by_reflection.IPromotionBag: PromotionId, PortalId, ProfileId, Discount, MinimumOrderAmount, Required*MinimumQuantity, DiscountedProductQuantity, coupon flags, PromoCode, PromotionMessage, PromotionName, PromotionTypeId, BuyingQuantity, DiscountedQuantity, MaxQtyToDiscount, MinimumWeight, Coupons. It has NO Attributes member
verified_by_reflection.IPromotionInfo: has Attributes (IReadOnlyList<PromotionAttributeInfo>), Discount, OrderMinimum, QuantityMinimum, ClassName, ClassType
verified_by_reflection.IExtensionLogger: Znode.Libraries.Extensions.Observability.Services, package 10.0.0-rc-01: BeginLog, CommitAsync, LogInformationAsync, LogWarningAsync, LogErrorAsync(extensionName, className, method, Exception, executionTimeMs, correlationId) and LogErrorAsync(ExtensionLog, Exception). No Verbose level.

contract.shopper_context_verified: The promotion context exposes only ids for the shopper (UserId, ProfileId, PortalId, OrderId on IPromotionCart). No account or account-group property exists on IPromotionCart, IPromotionBag or IPromotionContext in this package version.
contract.kb_conflict: The KB Promotion Extensibility Developer Guide sample reads Context.PromotionBag.Attributes[...]; IPromotionBag has no Attributes member in 10.0.0-rc-01 (IPromotionInfo does). Follow the package; do not copy that sample.
contract.demo_reference: A worked, tested example (percentage off the order subtotal at a minimum item count) was built and unit-tested in demo request ND-DEMO-003 on 2026-10-10: 24 xUnit tests passed; engine behaviour NOT verified live.

evidence.note: the only sample: flat order-level amount

evidence.path: Znode10.Libraries.Promotions.SDK 10.0.0-rc-01: CartPromotionTypeBase, IPromotionContext, IPromotionCart, IPromotionBag, IPromotionInfo

limitations: Profile-based scoping exists in the standard promotion configuration: check whether a user profile can stand in for the account group before writing code (verdict may then be Supported)
Packages are release-candidate versions in the sample

Verified by reflection: the shopper is available only as ids (UserId, ProfileId, PortalId). An account-group discount therefore needs an id-based lookup through ServiceProvider (a Znode client or service) that no source has shown; until verified the answer for 'discount by account group' is: use a price list or a profile-scoped promotion, or ask Znode
platform_change_if: the required condition is not exposed to promotion extensions
the discount must apply at a calculation stage the Promotions SDK does not offer

unverified: any documented way to look up account or account-group data from inside Calculate (ServiceProvider services are not documented)
line-level and shipping-level discount results (only OrderLevelDiscount is in the sample)
engine behaviour at run time: stacking, caps, when Calculate is called (code-only; not verified on an environment)
